author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for Fantasy Miniatures
content: WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! ⚔️ The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required. Typically no turnarounds required, occasional weapon or prop details may be needed. Often there will be multiple poses which will require loose sketches. We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis. If you enjoy designing characters and monsters but don't like spending weeks on the same design then this is for you. You will be able to work on many designs and someone who works quick will thrive in this role. The quicker you work the more we can send you. Creativity is extremely valuable and there is lots of room for creative freedom. People who don't work quickly, or are unable to take direction and revisions won't do well in this position. The following skill sets are required. in depth understanding of human anatomy, in depth understanding of creature and animal anatomy, great drawing and sketching skills, understanding of dynamic posing. All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio. We do not accept applications, review portfolios, answer hiring questions, or conduct any part of the recruitment process through Instagram, including DMs and comments. Please review the full job description and follow the application instructions provided there. Good luck!

author: smorgasburg
title: Looking for illustrator for 2027 NYC vendor flyer
content: Smorgasburg, through your eyes. Calling all local artists! We’re looking for a local illustrator or designer to create our 2027 NYC vendor application flyer! This is a paid commission, with full artist credit and the potential for many future collaborations. We want to see something different from our past flyers. Something unmistakably New York that captures the messy, human experience of eating here: hands making food, friends sharing a bite, cultures meeting across a counter. Your style, your perspective. Submit your portfolio or Instagram through the link in bio by November 10. A sketch is optional, but including one helps us understand your vision and may speed up our review—rough ideas are welcome. The final flyer, featuring the selected artist’s work, will be posted on November 20. Know someone we should see? Tag them below.
